svg.title: What I work on
svg.desc: What I work on. Agents: Autonomous systems, multimodal intelligence and agentic workflows. Interfaces: Spatial computing, gesture-driven systems and human-machine interaction. Security: Security engineering, ethical hacking and resilient AI systems. Product: Product strategy, Founder's Office execution and ideas built into reality. Each area has a moving object drawn in ASCII: a node network sphere, a fan of glass panels, a turning vault mechanism and a glass monolith.
